duration.text: The Flight Vehicle Environment and Life Protection Engineering at Beihang University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: 1.Applicants are expected to study hard, observe the Chinese laws and the regulations of BUAA and have the equivalent of a high school education. 2.Applicants are expected to have good scores and studied hard in high school. 3.Applicants should be under thirty five years old in general. 4.Applicants have Chinese proficiency of HSK grade 5 or above; 5.Applicants should attend the entrance examination and meet the requirements of BUAA.
